1374: Yugi Mutou is the main protagonist of Yu-Gi-Oh! Duel Monsters. At the start of the series, he is a shy boy who is really short for his age, something he always gets teased about in school. For this reason, he was always alone.
1375: Yami no Yuugi is the spirit residing in the Milennium Puzzle. After a historic battle against Zorc Necrophadius, he had sealed his soul along with Zorc in order to save Egypt. However, he had lost his memory as a result.
1377: Jonouchi is Yugi's best friend. At the beginning Jonouchi used to bully Yugi but after being saved by Yugi from an even more of a dangerous thug, Jonouchi has been pals with Yugi ever since. Jonouchi likes to hang around with Yugi and learns a lot of new games.
1378: Seto Kaiba is the majority shareholder and President of his own multi-national company, KaibaCorp, who aims to become the world's greatest player of the Duel Monsters card game. To accomplish this goal, he must defeat his arch-rival, Yugi Muto.
1379: Anzu is the childhood friend of Yugi Mutou. She becomes a good friend to Katsuya Jonouchi and Hiroto Honda, though she is not fond of them at first. In the first series anime, Miho Nosaka is also one of Anzu's friends.
1380: Another one of Yugi's friends. Honda used to bully Yugi with Jounouchi. He never understood Yugi's fashination with games but he was able to understand the feelings of others. Honda always helps Jounouchi or Yugi when they are in need. He's a friend to the end.
1381: Kaiba's little brother. Mokuba is always following Seto where ever he goes. He has a very strong bond with his brother and has all of his faith within Seto as well. Mokuba helps run Seto's company and will do what ever it takes to please his brother.
1488: Bakura Ryou is a classmate and friend of Yugi Muto. Yami Bakura is his other self, released from the power of the Millennium Ring. The two rarely directly converse.
1489: The strange dark spirit that lies inside the Millennium Ring. He searches for all the other Millennium items. Although the purpose is unknown, it's obvious that the intent is pure evil.
1501: Miho is your regular ditsy girl that's always hungry. She's very kind and likes to hang around with Anzu alot. She becomes friends with everyone so easily and is seen as the most beautiful girl in school.
5989: Shizuka is Katsuya Jonouchi's little sister. In the manga and the Duel Monsters anime, Jonouchi enters a Duel Monsters tournament hoping to win and use the prize money for Shizuka's eye surgery. Shizuka sees Mai Kujaku as a role model.
5995: Shadi is the guardian of the tomb, the original resting place of the seven Millennium Items. He is the reincarnation of one of the Pharaoh's six priests 3,000 years ago.
10815: Ushio is a security staff who observes residents around the Satellite area. He has a violent character but holds high esteem as a duelist on his muscles. If you remember, Ushio appears once in the first episode of [Yu Gi Oh series 0].
13297: Ryuzaki is the runner-up in the Japanese Duel Monsters tournament. He is good friends with the champion Insector Haga, and tends to use cards related to dinosaurs (thus his nickname "Dinosaur") due to his love of dinosaurs.
16202: Sugoroku Mutou is the grandfather of Yugi Mutou, who gave him his famous Millennium Puzzle as a present, which he had recovered from the tomb of the Pharaoh Atem in his youth.
19410: Gozaburo was the original founder and CEO of Kaiba Corporation, which at that time was a successful arms manufacturer. He was also a world famous chess champion, which is how Seto and Mokuba heard of him at their orphanage.
35322: In Episode 14 of "Yu-Gi-Oh!", when Anzu realizes that Yugi is her mysterious crush, Anzu invites him on a date to an amusement park, intending to put herself in danger to see Dark Yugi.
38637: Ms. Chono, known in the English version of the Dungeon Dice Monsters video game as Miss Lynn Madusa, is a teacher at Domino High School.
40650: Ryuichi Fuha is the second game master, who has good luck with a television game show. Ryuchi pushes around Yugi and his friends until Yugi challenges him to a Shadow Game involving a game show.
42303: She was the nurse in charge of Jonouchi's sister. She has strong sense of responsibility.
146176: Jiro the Jorogumo was an escaped convict and master of disguise. He worked as manager at Burger World at the time Hiroto Honda, Miho Nosaka and Anzu Mazaki were working there. He disguised himself as Tetsuo Sasaki, another criminal, while committing several robberies.
146177: He is person who was framed by Jiro the Jorogumo. Jiro disguised himself as Tetsu and broke out of prison. While Tetsu also broke out and attempted to commit some robberies, he was also framed for a variety of crimes that were committed by Jiro.
